mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers policy responses and eventual recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 index signals robust manufacturing activity supporting earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) during periods when INDPRO > 100 and economy is in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to early recovery signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that prompts anticipated Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate profit deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment recovery phase, UNRATE declining below 8.5% signals labor market improvement boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) during periods when UNRATE declines from >9.0% to <8.5%.
